title: Save and load a Robot of exudyn.robotics, e.g. as HDF5 file
author: Claude-JG
description: A Robot imported from a URDF or built from a model (e.g. the Staubli TX2-90L of the joint frames with the graphics of its URDF) cannot be stored: the links, base, tool, their HTs and the graphics data must be written into a dict and read back. Proposed: Robot.GetDictionary and Robot.SetDictionary (or a Robot built from the dict), saved and loaded with SaveDictToHDF5 and LoadDictFromHDF5, extended where needed; textures of the graphics need the images in dicts (separate issue).
releaseNotes: Robot.GetDictionary() and Robot.SetDictionary(robotDict) of exudyn.robotics store and rebuild a robot with its parameters, links, base, tool and their graphics data, e.g. saved with exudyn.advancedUtilities.SaveDictToHDF5 and loaded with LoadDictFromHDF5; SaveDictToHDF5 stores a list of only int or only float values as one dataset, so that meshes are saved in a fraction of a second; the textures named by the graphics data are not included.
